slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
月黑风高，紫电狂闪。
闷雷震天，暴雨如注。
九州北境，燕国。
边境慕圣村，凄风惨厉，鬼哭狼嚎。
屠杀的尾声，鲜血被雨水冲刷成狰狞的血流，淡红，却充满死者的怨魂。
一百零八条生命，尽数断绝。
“哈哈哈哈哈！”尸体堆积，鲜血最深处，魔影狂笑，“美妙，美妙！多么令人陶醉的血液！杀，还要杀！要更多的鲜血！”
“师尊，慕圣村全村死绝，已无活口！”魔修厉天行的弟子禀报，“向西二十里，还有一古风镇，我们要现在前往吗？”
“要，当然要！”厉天行蓦然回头，惨白的老脸被一身黑袍衬得凶残至极，鹰爪似的的右手抓着村民死不瞑目的头颅，狞笑，“现在就去，屠镇，我要更多的鲜血，将我的血魔神功臻至化境！”
“是！”弟子刚要带路，就听到暴雨之中，传来一声刺耳的婴儿啼哭声，声音洪亮，气如沉钟。
“嗯？”厉天行寻着声音望去，然后冷冷地扫了那弟子一眼，眼神阴沉，“你不是说……无一活口吗？”
那一眼，充满杀意。
弟子冷汗混合雨水流了下来，三十多岁的中年男人居然一瞬间有种被死神收割的感觉，气势之强，让他几乎直接跪下。
“弟子这就去将那婴儿提来交给师尊解渴！”中年男人慌忙一拜，转身就往啼哭声传来的地方奔去，逃命似的。
可村庄泥泞的道路上，暴雨如织，有一道不知何时出现的人影挡住了他的去路。
“什么人？！”弟子惊骇。
紫电狂闪而过，照亮如铁的黑暗，让厉天行看到来人的模样。
那是一个不知活了多久的老妖怪，看上去年过七旬，一把山羊胡，一身破破烂烂的羊皮袍，拄着和他几乎同样高的木杖，木杖上还歪歪斜斜地挂着一个颇有年岁的酒葫芦。
“老头，滚开！不然，你死！”弟子看清来人，恶向胆边生，抓气成风，一掌拍向老人的天灵盖。
“唔，化血魔掌？”老头像是没看见弟子的杀招一般，打了个哈欠，却喝了一嘴的雨水。

他满不在乎，随手一拨，顿时，好似天旋地转，中年男人被老头操纵无形气浪拍中一般，斜飞出去，一头扎进泥泞小路旁的茅草屋，轰隆一声将草屋撞得烂碎！
“你找死！”弟子立马爬了出来，狂叫一声，气运丹田，魔风荡荡，化血魔掌击碎暴雨，血红色的手印划过凄厉的直线，直奔老者而去。
“你才找死。”老头懒散的眼神看也不看中年男人，猛呵一口气，“跪下！”
那口气，真是有如飞剑！
只见一瞬闪光，老头一口气息吐出，撕裂雨幕，直直地斩过弟子的脖颈。
“砰！”
中年男人双膝一软，狠狠地跪进泥泞里，头颅随之倾斜，从肩膀上滚轮下去，栽落在地，死不瞑目。
“老者，你是谁？”厉天行沉声喝问，“杀我弟子，当本尊不存在吗？”
“小小人尊，老头子还真不放在眼里。”酒葫芦老头慢悠悠地走在雨水肆流的村庄泥路里，一双草鞋几乎被厚厚的泥巴摘了去，“燕王境下，真是四宇清平啊，区区一个超凡至尊境的魔修，竟能如此嚣张，做出屠村此等恶行。”
“小小人尊？”厉天行笑了，嘴角狰狞，一口黄牙，“难不成，阁下是天尊？”
“非也。”酒葫芦老头摇头晃脑，一杖指出，酒葫芦酒液飞溅而出，“贫道，度你的人！”
三滴酒液飞出，竟然迎风暴涨，化而为剑！
“气运山河？！”厉天行大叫一声，浑身魔气暴涨，一时间暗红如血的气团将他环绕其中，身影窜动，竟是照面就要逃跑！
酒剑杀气凛然，如太岳压城。
只是滴酒飞出的瞬间，厉天行就知道眼前的老者恐怕境界远比天尊更可怕！
他立刻想逃，可魔气环绕，他却忽然有种尺寸万里的感觉，一时间如陷恶沼。
道家绝学，气运山河！
以无上道气操运山河灵脉，随时随地结阵，日行千里，或者咫尺天涯的神功！
酒剑气转瞬即至。
“魔威天下！”厉天行仰天怒吼，血魔气在他干瘦的身躯上化成一幅狰狞的魔甲。

这还不够。
“血化千机！”魔修双掌并出，魔元催动，千机梨花针瀑布般爆出，试图阻挡飞越而来的酒剑气。
content_en:
The moon was dark and the wind was high, and purple lightning flashed wildly.
The sky was thundering and the rain was pouring.
The northern border of Kyushu, Yan State.
In Mu Sheng Village on the border, there was a miserable wind and ghosts crying and wolves howling.
At the end of the massacre, the blood was washed by the rain into a ferocious stream, light red, but full of the resentful souls of the dead.
One hundred and eight lives, all cut off.
"Hahahahaha!" The corpses were piled up, and the blood was deepest. The demonic figure laughed wildly, "Wonderful, wonderful! What an intoxicating blood! Kill, kill more! Want more blood!"
"Master, the entire Mu Sheng Village is dead and there is no one left alive!" the disciple of Demon Cultivator Li Tianxing reported, "Twenty miles to the west, there is an ancient town. Do we want to go now?"
"Yes, of course!" Li Tianxing suddenly turned around, his pale old face framed by a black robe making him extremely ferocious, his right hand like an eagle's talon grasped the villagers' dead heads, and smiled ferociously, "Go now, Tu Zhen, I want more blood to perfect my blood demon magic!"
"Yes!" Just as the disciple was about to lead the way, he heard a shrill cry of a baby coming from the heavy rain. The voice was loud and breathy like a bell.
"Huh?" Li Tianxing looked for the voice, and then glanced at the disciple coldly, his eyes gloomy, "Didn't you say... there is no one left alive?"
That look was full of killing intent.
The disciple was dripping with cold sweat mixed with rain. The middle-aged man in his thirties felt as if he had been harvested by death for a moment. The momentum was so strong that he almost knelt down.
"Disciple, go and bring the baby to Master to quench his thirst!" The middle-aged man bowed hurriedly, turned around and ran towards the place where the cry came from, as if running for his life.
But on the muddy road in the village, a heavy rain was falling, and a figure who appeared at an unknown time blocked his way.
"Who?!" The disciple was horrified.
Purple lightning flashed past, illuminating the iron-like darkness, allowing Li Tianxing to see the appearance of the person coming.
It was an old monster who had lived for an unknown period of time. He looked to be over seventy years old. He had a goatee and a tattered sheepskin robe. He was leaning on a wooden staff that was almost as tall as him. There was also an old wine gourd hanging crookedly on the wooden staff.
"Old man, get out of here! Otherwise, you will die!" When the disciple saw the person coming clearly, he became angry and angry, and slapped the old man's Tianling Gai with his palm.
"Hmm, Blood Transformation Palm?" The old man yawned as if he hadn't seen his disciple's killing move, but took a sip of rainwater.
He didn't care and made a move. Suddenly, as if the world was spinning, the middle-aged man was hit by the invisible air wave manipulated by the old man. He flew out diagonally and plunged into the thatched hut beside the muddy road. With a roar, the thatched hut was smashed to pieces!
"You are looking for death!" The disciple immediately crawled out and screamed wildly. The luck in his dantian was swayed by the devil's wind, and his blood-turned devil's palm shattered the heavy rain. His blood-red handprints crossed a straight line and headed straight for the old man.
"You're just looking for death." The old man's lazy eyes didn't even look at the middle-aged man, and he took a deep breath, "Kneel down!"
That tone is really like a flying sword!
There was only a flash of light, and the old man let out a breath, tearing the rain curtain apart, and slashed straight through the disciple's neck.
"Bang!"
The middle-aged man's knees weakened and he knelt hard into the mud. His head tilted and rolled off his shoulders. He fell to the ground and died with his eyes open.
"Old man, who are you?" Li Tianxing asked in a deep voice, "Kill my disciple and pretend that I don't exist?"
"You little human being, the old man really doesn't take him seriously." The old man Jiu Gourd walked slowly on the dirt road of the village where the rain was pouring. His pair of straw sandals were almost torn off by the thick mud. "Under the realm of King Yan, the world is really peaceful. A mere demon cultivator in the extraordinary supreme realm can be so arrogant and commit such evil acts as slaughtering the village."
"Little human being?" Li Tianxing smiled, with a ferocious mouth and yellow teeth, "Is it possible that you are a deity?"
"No." The old man in the wine gourd shook his head and pointed out with his stick. The wine from the wine gourd splashed out, "I'm a poor Taoist, save your life."people! "
Three drops of wine flew out, swelled up in the storm, and turned into a sword!
"Luck in mountains and rivers? ! "Li Tianxing yelled, and the demonic energy all over his body surged. For a moment, a dark red air mass surrounded him. His figure moved around, and he was about to run away when he encountered him!
The murderous aura of the wine sword is like Mount Tai overwhelming the city.
Just the moment the drop of wine flew out, Li Tianxing knew that the old man in front of him might be far more terrifying than Tianzun!
He immediately wanted to run away, but when the demonic energy surrounded him, he suddenly felt like he was thousands of miles away, and for a moment he felt like he was trapped in a swamp.
The unique knowledge of Taoism brings luck to the mountains and rivers!
Use the supreme Tao Qi to control the spiritual veins of mountains and rivers, form formations anytime and anywhere, travel thousands of miles a day, or be so close to the end of the world!
The wine and sword energy arrived in an instant.
"The world of demons is powerful! "Li Tianxing roared up to the sky, and the blood demon energy turned into a ferocious magic armor on his thin body.
This is not enough.
"Blood Transformation Thousand Machines! "The demon cultivator stretched out his palms together, activated the demonic element, and Qianji pear blossom needles burst out like a waterfall, trying to block the flying wine sword energy.
